_doc: Which files belong to which browser-walked surface, for bin/smoke-gate.cjs.
A changed rendered file used to invalidate the whole smoke walk. A file listed here only makes its own
surface stale: re-walk that surface, record it under `surfaces` in the smoke report with the commit it ran
against, and the file is covered again.
Safety property: a file that matches NO glob here invalidates everything, exactly as before. A shared
helper, a new file, a rename or an unmapped directory therefore fails safe. This file can only narrow
invalidation for files someone deliberately mapped; list a file under a surface only when a walk of that
surface would notice a regression in it.
Globs: ** crosses directories, * stays inside one. `free` paths are relative to the Free plugin, `pro` to Pro.
